title: A broken icon reads as what breaks it: a crack through a heart, a split egg, a bubble in pieces
goal: Ask tears the outline of anything breaking at its upper right, which suits a balloon but makes a broken heart look bitten and a soap bubble look like a cracked egg. Each way of breaking should look like itself, and an object at its best without the tear should not be made worse by it.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-05. Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --cases icon-broken-heart,icon-cracked-egg-filled,icon-soap-bubble-bursting. Tear on, run 20261105-204948-ask: heart 55.4 (asked 5, icon 4), egg 70.6 (6, 5), bubble 54.8 (6, 6, named 1 of 3 as a cracked egg). Tear off for one build, run 20261105-213322-ask: heart 30.5, egg 84.8, bubble 71.3. One reading each, and one version of the balloon has swung by 30. The bubble sheet shows the tool leaves an inner highlight poking into the tear: AskIconBreak.applied leaves parts lying in the torn stretch alone. Ideas: a crack through the object as a second tear shape, chosen by the model from a general list, and dropping parts that lie in the gap. No subject may be coded. Without the tear (2026-11-09) means Ask with the break step off entirely: the model draws the broken thing by itself, as it does any other icon (a temporary build, iconBreak = nil in AskSession). Runs 20261109-021403/022206/023030 (tear on) and 024846/030827/031850 (off).
acceptance: A broken heart icon scores at least 7 of 10 on did what was asked and reads as an icon, over three readings
A cracked egg and a bursting soap bubble each score at least as well with the tear as without it, over three readings

The balloon popping scores at least as well with the tear as without it, over three readings on the steady judge (mean of nine looks, rubric 4a03a8fc); restated 2026-11-09 from "at or above 85", a number the old median judge reached only on the lucky side of a coin flip

One tear at the upper right serves only things with a skin. Risk: the model picking shattered for the balloon, which would lose its 85.
